about: Right-section test set for retrieve() (Role A). Each query is a misconception in the tutor's topics, written by hand (not Eedi text), with the section titles a correct passage may come from (either book). A query counts as a hit when one of the top-k passages is from a listed section.

queries.query: Adds the numerators and adds the denominators, e.g. 1/2 + 1/3 = 2/5
sections: Add and Subtract Fractions with Different Denominators

queries.query: Adds fractions with the same denominator by adding the denominators too, 2/7 + 3/7 = 5/14
sections: Add and Subtract Fractions with Common Denominators

queries.query: Keeps the common denominator when multiplying fractions, 2/5 x 3/5 = 6/5
Divides fractions by multiplying straight across without flipping the second fraction
Flips the first fraction instead of the divisor when dividing fractions
Simplifies a fraction by subtracting the same number from top and bottom
Thinks a fraction with a bigger denominator is bigger, 1/8 > 1/5
sections: Add and Subtract Fractions with Different Denominators

queries.query: Finds a common denominator but forgets to change the numerators
sections: Add and Subtract Fractions with Different Denominators

queries.query: Converts a mixed number to an improper fraction by multiplying the whole number by the numerator
sections: Multiply and Divide Mixed Numbers and Complex Fractions

queries.query: Multiplies mixed numbers by multiplying the whole numbers and the fractions separately
sections: Multiply and Divide Mixed Numbers and Complex Fractions

queries.query: Subtracts mixed numbers without borrowing from the whole number when the fraction part is too small
Thinks equivalent fractions are made by adding the same number to numerator and denominator
Thinks the decimal with more digits is larger, 0.25 > 0.3
Lines up the last digits instead of the decimal points when adding decimals
Counts decimal places wrongly when multiplying decimals, 0.2 x 0.3 = 0.6
Moves the decimal point the wrong way when dividing by 10
Writes 3/4 as 3.4 by putting the numerator and denominator either side of the point
Rounds a decimal by looking at the wrong digit
Thinks dividing by a decimal less than one always makes the number smaller
Reads 0.07 as seven tenths, confusing place value names
Converts a percentage to a decimal by moving the point one place, 5% = 0.5
Only multiplies the first term inside the bracket, 3(x + 2) = 3x + 2
Ignores the negative sign when expanding -2(x - 5)
Adds unlike terms together, 2x + 3 = 5x
Thinks 3x squared means (3x) squared when substituting
Does addition before multiplication, ignoring the order of operations
Adds the exponents when multiplying terms with different bases or multiplies exponents instead of adding
Thinks x times x is 2x
Expands (x + 3)(x + 2) as x squared + 6, multiplying only first and last terms
Subtracts a negative number by making the answer smaller, 5 - (-2) = 3
